dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts individuals with disabilities seeking employment or entrepreneurship, and small businesses looking to hire or improve accessibility.
dimensions.evidence: provide assistance to individuals with disabilities who desire to become entrepreneurs or to be self-employed

dimensions.assessment: Provides supportive services, outreach, and technical assistance without altering federal mandates or creating enforceable legal penalties.
dimensions.evidence: assist small business concerns with hiring individuals with disabilities and with accessibility issues

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits any additional funds from being authorized or appropriated to carry out the requirements.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to carry out the requirements of this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Requires an inter-agency agreement, outreach, education, and a report to Congress within two years.
dimensions.evidence: carry out and coordinate the activities described in subsection (a) by entering into one or more memoranda of understanding

dimensions.assessment: Involves ongoing coordination and a one-time report due two years after enactment, but contains no permanent new program authorization.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than two years after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Administrator... shall submit to Congress a report

missing_information: Specific metrics or targets for employment growth
Details on how existing funds will be reallocated to support these activities without new appropriations
importance_detail.rationale: This bill mandates a memorandum of understanding between the Small Business Administration and the National Council on Disability to boost entrepreneurship and employment for individuals with disabilities, but explicitly authorizes no additional funds.
